rows.input: the answer of GET /api/health when the page loads
rows.why: skeleton only: it writes one line of text. Phase 3 replaces it by the bootstrap through api.js and the store's fence

rows.metadata: generation of the request for its resource; epoch and seq of X-Pixdcon-Position
rows.fence: ordering.js beginRequest and openSource before the request is sent; the store decides with decideView, decideAnswer or decideSnapshot

rows.input: the answers of the form's preview and save requests
rows.metadata: draft number of the form; rev of the SettingsState in the answer
rows.fence: ordering.js decideView; an answer for an older draft than the one on screen is not shown

rows.input: the events of the live stream, its open and its error, the 5 s reconnect timer, the 20 s silence timer
rows.metadata: epoch and seq from the event id; generation of the stream
rows.fence: ordering.js openSource for every new stream; the store applies an event only through decideEvent; the two timers change only the connection state that is shown

rows.input: a snapshot: the bootstrap answer, or the first event of a stream
rows.metadata: epoch, seq, generation of its source
rows.test: test/contract/ordering.test.js: F5: a snapshot that a newer source has overtaken

rows.metadata: epoch, seq, stream generation; a view inside carries its own epoch and rev
rows.fence: ordering.js decideEvent, then decideView for a view
rows.test: test/contract/ordering.test.js: F5: an event is applied only on the newest stream

rows.metadata: request generation, epoch and seq; rev for a view
